name: sos-sang
description: SOS Sang - plateforme de mise en relation entre hopitaux et donneurs de sang

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @sos/auth-service -w @sos/donor-service -w @sos/hospital-service -w @sos/matching-service -w @sos/notification-service -w @sos/stock-service -w @sos/dashboard-service -w @sos/gateway && npm run build -w @sos/frontend
scripts.dev:watch: npm run build:shared && tsx watch scripts/embedded.ts
scripts.lint: tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p services/auth-service --noEmit && tsc -p services/donor-service --noEmit && tsc -p services/hospital-service --noEmit && tsc -p services/matching-service --noEmit && tsc -p services/notification-service --noEmit && tsc -p services/stock-service --noEmit && tsc -p services/dashboard-service --noEmit && tsc -p gateway --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w @sos/frontend
